reason: The hypothesis combines the known effect of Al on protective oxide formation (P6, P9) with the known detrimental role of Mn diffusion (P1, P18) and extends it to Si substitution, proposing a dual-layer stress-accommodation mechanism that links diffusion kinetics to mechanical integrity, which is not explicitly stated in any single passage. However, the core idea of replacing Mn with Al to improve oxidation resistance is directly reported as a result in P6 and P9, and the mechanism of cation diffusion control is well-established in the literature (P1, P23, P37), making the hypothesis largely a restatement of existing findings with a minor extension to Si.
